verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API Reference with an agent-friendly markdown version, and an official MCP server built for external agents (a probe confirmed it). It also serves an llms.txt index, and the APM and Log Management docs show metrics, logs and traces are first-class data an agent could query. missing for 10: evidence explicitly detailing which metric/log/trace query endpoints or MCP tools exist, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production through these APIs.
